main.caption: Results-management decision logic as implemented, with the two outcomes added during implementation marked.
main.note: Conditions: Q001, sample analysis positive; Q002, laboratory accreditation state (verified, pending or unverified); Q003, longitudinal profile anomaly flagged; Q004, expert panel review required; Q005, third whereabouts failure within a rolling 12-month window; Q006, all failures ledger-verified; Q007, mandatory custody step verified. Rules are evaluated in the precedence order shown and the first match determines the outcome; lower-precedence matches are retained in the record rather than discarded. Rows R2b and R0 were absent from the decision table as originally specified and were added during implementation, because a function that must return exactly one outcome for every input cannot leave the affirmatively unverified accreditation state, or the no-match case, undefined. AAF, adverse analytical finding; ABP, Athlete Biological Passport; ADRV, anti-doping rule violation; NADO, national anti-doping organisation; WADA, World Anti-Doping Agency.
